g.text: RootCanal: How C++ communicates with the Rust modules (FFI bridge)
In C++ there is no separate "Rust controller" object.
The Rust code is a pure-library state machine embedded in
(A) "outer" C ABI = the C++ controller calls INTO Rust
(B) "inner" callbacks = Rust calls BACK into C++ through the
